page_title: KOL 3-2 UNI | FC Koln v Union Berlin 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' 3 - 2 Goal! A great cross from Linton Maina finds Damion Downs (1. FC Koln), who scores with a simple header into an empty net. 3:2.

90+1' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Frederik Ronnow is alert and denies him with a nice save.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
89' No offside! Referee Deniz Aytekin points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the FC Koln players.
89' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The FC Koln players aren’t happy.
87' 2 - 2 Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) scores a goal with a brilliant header that goes inside the right post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
86' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) will deliver the corner kick.

84' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

83' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Marvin Schwabe with a brilliant diving save!
81' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post.
80' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) storms into the middle of the box and connects with a smart cross from Dominique Heintz, the keeper is helpless but the header flies just over the bar.
78' Good movement by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
78' A lofted cross from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
77' The attendance for today's match is 50000.
75' Timo Schultz decides to make a substitution. Faride Alidou will be replaced by Damion Downs (1. FC Koln).
74' The referee is firm and issues Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) a deserved yellow card. Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
73' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
72' Substitution. Christopher Trimmel leaves the pitch and is replaced by Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin).
72' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just over the bar.
68' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
67' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

66' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) has an effort from distance but it's blocked. Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the right post, but Frederik Ronnow makes a decent save to stop the effort.
65' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
65' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
64' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to FC Koln.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eric Martel leaves the pitch and Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) comes on.
61' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Marvin Schwabe was alert and made an amazing save!
60' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) is being substituted because of an injury. Marco Grote sends Lucas Tousart on the pitch.
58' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
57' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

57' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Marvin Schwabe easily deals with the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Union Berlin will take a corner.
54' Substitution. Kevin Volland did his best and is replaced by Chris Bedia (Union Berlin).
54' Marco Grote has decided to substitute Brenden Aaronson and he is replaced by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin).
53' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
52' The resulting corner from Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
52' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Linton Maina (1. FC Koln). FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot over the bar.
49' Dangerous play by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln). Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin will take a free kick near the side line.
48' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
46' Timo Schultz makes a half-time substitution. Dominique Heintz comes on in place of Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln).
46' Half-time substitution. Timo Schultz decided to make a change. Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) is replaced by Steffen Tigges.
46' The game is over for Rani Khedira (Union Berlin). Janik Haberer comes on for the second half.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
45+4' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) makes a slide tackle, but referee Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul. FC Koln are awarded the free kick.
45+4' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 1 - 2 Goal! Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Frederik Ronnow.
45' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
44' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected. Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) will miss the next game.
44' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to FC Koln!
44' A dangerous looking corner kick from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is cleared to safety by the defence.
42' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
41' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marvin Schwabe intercepts the ball.
41' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
39' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
37' The free kick into the penalty area from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cleared.
36' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card. Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
36' Frederik Ronnow leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln).
35' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. FC Koln will take a corner kick.
34' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) sends a long ball in, but Frederik Ronnow comfortably gathers the ball.
33' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
30' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

29' The cross into the penalty area from Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
26' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
26' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Union Berlin get a corner.
22' Referee Deniz Aytekin sees the trip by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
20' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is substituted due to injury. Timo Schultz gives a chance to Linton Maina.
19' 0 - 2 Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Marvin Schwabe to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
19' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) is going to take the penalty!
18' Referee Deniz Aytekin awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
17' There's a break in play and referee Deniz Aytekin must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Union Berlin using VAR. This could be interesting!
17' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
16' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
16' A cross into the box from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cleared. Union Berlin force a corner. They send men into the box.

15' 0 - 1 Christopher Trimmel sends the resulting corner into the box and expertly finds Robin Knoche (Union Berlin), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the roof of the net. It's 0:1.
15' Corner kick. Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is ready to send the ball into the box.

14' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
13' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle after Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. A free kick to Union Berlin.
11' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) commits a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well wide of the right post.
5' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes a short free kick.
4' The game is interrupted now, Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

4' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to FC Koln, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
3' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
1' The first half has started.
FC Koln will kick the game off.
Deniz Aytekin was nominated as the referee for this game.
